brand.name: Summer Soft Skincare
brand.description: A premium skincare brand built on barrier-repair science for sensitive skin.
brand.positioning: Clinically-informed, fragrance-free skincare for people with reactive skin. Editorial, not hype-driven. We partner with creators who explain ingredients rather than just showing results.

gifting.notes: Each gift carries its own criteria. There is no brand-level gate: a creator can qualify for some offers and not others, and the agents suggest the best one they do qualify for.

offers.name: Barrier Repair Serum
offers.description: Ceramide and panthenol overnight serum for dry, reactive, compromised skin barriers. Our hero gifting SKU.

offers.name: Hydrating Cleanser
offers.description: Non-stripping gel cleanser with glycerin and oat, for daily use on sensitive skin.

offers.name: Discovery Set
offers.description: A three-piece starter set of our bestsellers, for creators new to the brand.

pitch.notes: The admin chooses which verified metrics score a pitch. Weights are relative; the score is always normalised to 0-100 so the tag thresholds mean the same thing.

classification_labels.label: Excellent Match
classification_labels.description: Strong on nearly every metric we score.
classification_labels.response_instructions: Ask for the specific deliverables, timeline and usage rights you still need before moving to a brief, and say the team will pick it up from here.

classification_labels.label: Promising
classification_labels.description: Worth exploring, with clear gaps to fill.
classification_labels.response_instructions: Ask which formats they would propose and what their rates are, and which audience data they can share. Say you will review it with the team.

classification_labels.label: Not a fit
classification_labels.description: Below the bar on the metrics we score.
classification_labels.response_instructions: Say it is not a fit right now, that you will keep them in mind for future campaigns, and thank them for reaching out. Do not ask for more detail.

router.instructions: Route on the creator's primary intent. A request for a free product is a gift_request even when phrased as a question. A message offering to collaborate, pitching content or asking to be considered as a partner is a creator_pitch.
router.constraints: Never approve gifts and never commit to a partnership -- you only classify and hand off.

gift_request.instructions: Find the gift that matches what the creator asked about before discussing eligibility, and offer the best gift they actually qualify for. When they ask about something they do not qualify to be gifted, you may still share the product link so they can buy it.
gift_request.constraints: Never promise a gift before issue_gift returns success, and never imply a linked product is free. Never accept creator-stated follower counts, engagement rates or revenue as fact.

creator_pitch.instructions: Acknowledge the pitch warmly, evaluate it against the brand profile, apply exactly one tag from the configured label set, then follow that tag's response instructions for your reply.
creator_pitch.constraints: Only apply the label returned by check_pitch_fit. Never commit to a paid campaign, rate or deliverable.

general_inquiry.instructions: Answer from the brand description and the gift catalog. Offer to help with a gifting request or a partnership pitch.
general_inquiry.constraints: Never approve gifts, never commit to partnerships, never quote unpublished terms.
